ideas.pitch: An agentic knowledge-capture system that intercepts developer offboarding friction by indexing commits, pull requests, and Slack decisions into a LangGraph agent that automatically trains new engineers.
ideas.title: Agentic Engineer Lifecycle Knowledge Base
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a universally felt developer pain point and builds on proven architecture from similar hackathon winners like devflow.

ideas.pitch: An agentic IT service desk workflow that automatically triages incoming support tickets, pulls logs from GitHub/Datadog, runs diagnostic tools, and drafts fixes without human intervention.
ideas.title: Autonomous ITSM Triage and Resolution Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies enterprise automation patterns that judges immediately recognize as high-value, similar to winning ITSM copilot solutions.

ideas.pitch: An agent that intercepts stack traces or runtime logs from an application, traces the root cause across multiple repository files, writes a patch, and generates unit tests automatically.
ideas.title: Runtime Error to Multi-File Repair Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on deep, practical developer tooling with a crystal-clear live demo of fixing a broken test suite in seconds.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic routing layer that dynamically selects the best tool or API for an autonomous agent using kNN over an exemplar index with LLM-judge writeback.
ideas.title: Self-Improving Semantic Router for Agent Tools
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering and algorithmic optimization rather than just wrapping a basic LLM prompt.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight agentic registry that coordinates specialized medical-data AI agents across isolated databases using model context protocols and secure tool-sharing.
ideas.title: Federated Medical Data Agent Registry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles complex distributed agent architectures which score exceptionally well in technical evaluation criteria.
